## Safety checklist / 安全检查

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] No payload, firmware, backup, session directory, full serial number, or
      secret is included.
- [ ] Unknown models, firmware, routes, paths, and packages still fail closed.
- [ ] Device writes still require the correct fresh gates and one-time
      authorization.
- [ ] Physical, simulated, and CI evidence are clearly distinguished.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and compatibility limits are documented.
